hooks.name: Build Static No-API Version
hooks.description: When files under backend/ or frontend/ are saved, triggers a static build that uses mock data and doesn't require any API or .env credentials.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Output 'Generating static no-API build...'; Set-Location frontend; npm run build:static 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Output '[OK] Static (no-API) build generated at frontend/dist-static/'; } else { Write-Output '[WARN] Static build failed. Check build:static script in package.json.'; }"
